verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation or workflow feature that runs autonomously in the background. What it does show are fixed automatic behaviors: auto-issued license keys, dunning card retries, and auto-updating segments. It also documents webhooks, which a developer could use to build automations elsewhere. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the product's own automation capability, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
